turns.content: Can you save cards for repeat customers? And would that change our PCI compliance level?

Yes, Acme Checkout supports saving cards for repeat customers! When a customer chooses to save their card, we securely store the card details on our servers and provide you with a secure token for future transactions.

This does not increase your PCI compliance burden. Because Acme Checkout handles the capture and storage of all sensitive cardholder data, the card details never touch your servers. This keeps your PCI scope at the lowest level (typically SAQ A), allowing you to offer a seamless checkout experience without extra compliance overhead. 

Let us know if you have any questions on setting this up!

turns.content: Bonjour! How do I show prices in EUR instead of USD at checkout?

Bonjour Chloé!

To display prices in EUR at checkout, you can update your currency settings directly in your Acme dashboard:

1. Go to **Settings** > **Localization & Currency**.
2. Under **Default Currency**, select **EUR (€)**.
3. Click **Save Changes**.

Once updated, your checkout will automatically present prices to your customers in euros. 

Please let us know if you need any help setting this up!
